title: Learning symplectic model reduction based on an approximation theorem of symplectic embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2606.04623v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: High-dimensional Hamiltonian systems play a central role in many scientific and engineering disciplines, with dynamics that evolve on symplectic manifolds. Although deep learning provides powerful tools for constructing its low-dimensional surrogates from data, the intrinsic symplectic structure is easily destroyed during model reduction. As a result, a standard autoencoder may produce latent coordinates that do not support a Hamiltonian flow, leading to unstable long-time prediction. In this paper, we first establish a universal approximation theorem for symplectic embeddings. And based on the theory, we propose symplecticity-preserving autoencoders (SpAE), in which the decoder is parameterized as a symplectic embedding and the encoder is constructed as the corresponding symplectic projection. translated_title: 基于辛嵌入逼近定理的学习辛模型降阶
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.04623v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：高维哈密顿系统在许多科学和工程领域中扮演核心角色，其动力学在辛流形上演化。尽管深度学习为从数据构建其低维替代模型提供了强大工具，但内在的辛结构在模型降阶过程中容易被破坏。因此，标准自编码器可能产生不支撑哈密顿流的潜在坐标，导致长时间预测不稳定。本文首先建立了辛嵌入的通用逼近定理。基于该理论，我们提出了保持辛性的自编码器（SpAE），其中解码器被参数化为辛嵌入，编码器被构造为相应的辛投影。该架构具有足够的表达力来逼近非线性辛嵌入及相应的辛投影，并保持辛性。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于辛嵌入逼近定理的保持辛性自编码器，通过参数化解码器为辛嵌入和编码器为辛投影，确保模型降阶后保留哈密顿系统的辛结构，从而实现稳定的长时间预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a symplecticity-preserving autoencoder based on an approximation theorem for symplectic embeddings, parameterizing the decoder as a symplectic embedding and the encoder as a symplectic projection to preserve the symplectic structure during model reduction, enabling stable long-time prediction.
